newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Aftab Automobiles offers rights share.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Aftab Automobiles offers rights share.

text.p: Bangladesh's Aftab Automobiles Ltd had decided to offer rights shares worth about 950 million taka to finance its expansion programme, company officials said on Sunday.
"We are building a multipurpose vehicle manufacturing unit under the expansion programme," company Secretary Kazi Mostafa Alam told Reuters.
The company will issue two rights shares against each share held by investors at 250 taka including a premium of 150 taka.
The book closure will begin on March 22 and end on March 25.
